chapter_note: Cosmological substrate dominates: a tightly-structured triadic teaching of the three great rocks (Perfect Man/Ambassador as world-bearer; new land of light on the land of darkness; great Thought/Jesus). The first two members are pure cosmic mappings (cosmos→cosmos). The third member breaks the pattern: 'Jesus the Glorious One' is placed 'in the holy Church' — at this point one side of the mapping reaches into the editor's contemporary ecclesial institution. The editorial seam in i=17-19 is the classic 'extend the cosmic triad with an institutional iteration' pattern. The closing summary (i=20-23) returns to substrate voice.
